# nostr.build

> Free and paid media hosting for the Nostr ecosystem: upload and share images,
> video and audio, organize a library with folders, generate images with AI, and
> let AI agents manage it all over MCP.

## For AI agents

- [Agent setup](https://account.nostr.build/agent-setup.md): connect to a user's
  account over MCP (streamable HTTP with a bearer token), with the full tool list,
  scopes, per-client config snippets and etiquette
- MCP endpoint: https://account.nostr.build/mcp - tokens are minted by the account
  owner from the Connected agents button in the dashboard header

## Product

- [Account dashboard](https://account.nostr.build/): manage media, folders, plans
  and connected agents (sign in required)
- [Features](https://account.nostr.build/features): what accounts include, tier by tier
- [Plans](https://account.nostr.build/plans): pricing and how payment works
- [About](https://account.nostr.build/about): who runs nostr.build and why
- [Terms of service](https://account.nostr.build/tos)
- [Privacy policy](https://account.nostr.build/privacy)
